name: esp32_round1
description: ESP32 camera, worn as in the demo. Record the same five scenarios as phone_round2 with scripts/record_stream.py, then fill in the windows (seconds) from scripts/contact_sheet.py. Clips with empty windows still run (timelines and memories), they just aren't scored.

clips.note: carry keys ~5 s, put them on a textured surface, keep them in view ~3 s, look away ~8 s, look back from another angle
put keys on a cluttered desk (laptop, cables, cans), keep in view ~3 s, walk away
30 s of a cluttered desk WITH NO KEYS anywhere (laptops with keyboards, cables, phones)
start across the room, walk back to the keys from 01, pick them up
put keys down and walk away within ~2 s (the hard case)
